common.copy_link: If the button above doesn't work, you can copy and paste the following link into your browser:
password_reset.subject: Endurain - Password reset
password_reset.heading: Password reset request
password_reset.intro: You requested to reset your password for your Endurain account. Click the button below to reset your password:
password_reset.security_notice: This link will expire in 1 hour for security reasons.
password_reset.ignore: If you didn't request this password reset, please ignore this email. Your password will remain unchanged.
signup_confirmation.subject: Endurain - Confirm your account
signup_confirmation.heading: Confirm your account
signup_confirmation.intro: Thank you for signing up for Endurain! Confirm your email address and choose your password by clicking the button below:
signup_confirmation.security_notice: This confirmation link will expire in 24 hours.
signup_confirmation.ignore: If you didn't create an Endurain account, please ignore this email.
admin_invitation.subject: Endurain - An administrator created your account
admin_invitation.heading: Your account is ready
admin_invitation.intro: An administrator created an Endurain account for you. Choose your password to confirm your email address and start using it:
admin_invitation.security_notice: This confirmation link will expire in 24 hours.
admin_invitation.ignore: If you weren't expecting this account, please ignore this email.
email_change_confirmation.subject: Endurain - Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirmation.heading: Confirm your new email address
email_change_confirmation.intro: A change of the email address of your Endurain account to this address was requested. The change takes effect once you confirm it by clicking the button below:
email_change_confirmation.security_notic: This confirmation link will expire in 24 hours.
email_change_confirmation.ignore: If you didn't expect this change, contact your Endurain administrator, as someone else may have access to your account.
email_change_requested.subject: Endurain - A change of your email address was requested
email_change_requested.heading: A change of your email address was requested
email_change_requested.intro: Someone asked to change the email address of your Endurain account to {new_email}. Nothing has changed yet: the change takes effect only when the link sent to that address is opened, and this address stays in use until then.
email_change_requested.security_notice: If you didn't ask for this, use the button above. It cancels the change, signs your account out everywhere and revokes its API keys. Then reset your password, as someone else may know it.
email_change_requested.ignore: If this was you, you can ignore this email.
email_change_requested_admin.subject: Endurain - An administrator asked to change your email address
email_change_requested_admin.heading: An administrator asked to change your email address
email_change_requested_admin.intro: An administrator asked to change the email address of your Endurain account to {new_email}. Nothing has changed yet: the change takes effect only when the new address confirms it, and this address stays in use until then.
email_change_requested_admin.ignore: If you did not expect this change, contact your administrator.
email_changed.subject: Endurain - Your email address was changed
email_changed.heading: Your email address was changed
email_changed.intro: The email address of your Endurain account was changed to {new_email}. You will no longer receive account emails at this address.
email_changed.security_notice: If you didn't make this change, contact your Endurain administrator right away, as someone else may have access to your account.
email_changed.security_notice_revertible: If you didn't make this change, use the button above within {days} days of the request. It puts your previous address back when it is still free, signs your account out everywhere and revokes its API keys. Then reset your password, as someone else may know it.
security_change.recovery_effects: Any API keys on the account were revoked, so create new ones in Settings → Security, and any pending email change was cancelled.
security_change.security_notice: If you didn't make this change, reset your password right away and review your account's security settings, as someone else may have access to your account.
security_change.security_notice_admin: If you didn't expect this change, contact your Endurain administrator right away, as someone else may have access to your account.
security_change.password_changed.subject: Endurain - Your password was changed
security_change.password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
security_change.password_changed.intro: The password of your Endurain account was changed.
security_change.password_reset.subject: Endurain - Your password was reset
security_change.password_reset.heading: Your password was reset
security_change.password_reset.intro: The password of your Endurain account was reset using a password reset link.
security_change.password_set_by_admin.su: Endurain - An administrator set your password
security_change.password_set_by_admin.in: An administrator set a new password for your Endurain account.
security_change.mfa_reset_by_admin.subje: Endurain - An administrator reset your two-factor authentication
security_change.mfa_reset_by_admin.headi: An administrator reset your two-factor authentication
security_change.mfa_reset_by_admin.intro: An administrator reset two-factor authentication for your Endurain account and signed you out of all devices. Set up two-factor authentication again from your security settings after you sign in.
security_change.password_change_required: Endurain - An administrator required a password change
An administrator required a password change
An administrator required you to change your Endurain password and signed you out of all devices. You will be asked to choose a new password the next time you sign in with your password.
security_change.mfa_enabled.subject: Endurain - Two-factor authentication was turned on
security_change.mfa_enabled.heading: Two-factor authentication was turned on
security_change.mfa_enabled.intro: Two-factor authentication was turned on for your Endurain account.
security_change.mfa_disabled.subject: Endurain - Two-factor authentication was turned off
security_change.mfa_disabled.heading: Two-factor authentication was turned off
security_change.mfa_disabled.intro: Two-factor authentication was turned off for your Endurain account.
security_change.backup_codes_generated.s: Endurain - New backup codes were generated
security_change.backup_codes_generated.i: New backup codes were generated for your Endurain account.
security_change.api_key_created.subject: Endurain - A new API key was created
security_change.api_key_created.heading: A new API key was created
security_change.api_key_created.intro: A new API key was created for your Endurain account.
security_change.api_keys_revoked_by_admi: Endurain - API keys of your account were revoked
API keys of your account were revoked
An administrator revoked one or more API keys of your Endurain account.
security_change.identity_provider_linked: Endurain - A sign-in provider was linked
A sign-in provider was linked to your Endurain account.
The sign-in provider {provider} was linked to your Endurain account.
security_change.identity_provider_unlink: Endurain - A sign-in provider was unlinked
A sign-in provider was unlinked from your Endurain account.
security_change.account_locked.subject: Endurain - Your account was locked
security_change.account_locked.heading: Your account was locked
security_change.account_locked.intro: Your Endurain account was locked after 100 failed sign-in attempts in a row. Browsers and apps you have signed in from since your last security change can still sign in. Anyone else is refused for 30 days, until the password is reset or changed.
security_change.mfa_locked.subject: Endurain - Two-step verification sign-in was locked
security_change.mfa_locked.heading: Two-step verification sign-in was locked
security_change.mfa_locked.intro: Your Endurain account was locked after 100 wrong two-step verification codes in a row. Whoever entered them knew your password. Browsers and apps you have signed in from since your last security change can still sign in. Anyone else is refused for 30 days, until two-step verification is turned off or set up again, or an administrator resets it.
security_change.security_notice_mfa_lock: If these attempts weren't yours, someone knows your password. Change your password right away from a signed-in device and review your account's security settings.
security_change.security_notice_account_: If these attempts weren't yours, someone is guessing your password. Change or reset your password right away, which also lifts the lock, and review your account's security settings.
security_change.step_up_session_ended.su: Endurain - A session was signed out after wrong confirmations
security_change.step_up_session_ended.he: A session was signed out after wrong confirmations
security_change.step_up_session_ended.in: A session of your Endurain account was signed out after 15 wrong password or two-step verification codes in a row were entered to confirm a sensitive action. Whoever entered them was signed in as you. Your other sessions were not affected. Sign in again on the device that was signed out.
security_change.step_up_locked.subject: Endurain - Confirming sensitive actions was locked
security_change.step_up_locked.heading: Confirming sensitive actions was locked
security_change.step_up_locked.intro: Confirming sensitive actions on your Endurain account, such as changing your password or creating an API key, was locked after 100 wrong confirmations across your sessions. Every confirmation is refused for 30 days, until you reset your password or an administrator sets it. Your sessions stay signed in.
security_change.security_notice_step_up_: If these attempts weren't yours, someone is signed in to your account. Reset your password right away, which also lifts the lock, and review your account's security settings.
security_change.identity_provider_unlink: The sign-in provider {provider} was unlinked from your Endurain account.
security_change.security_notice_session: If this wasn't you, someone may have copied your session. Change your password right away and review your account's security settings.
security_change.security_notice_backup_c: If this wasn't you, someone knows your password and has a backup code. Change your password right away and generate new backup codes in Settings → Security.
security_change.backup_code_used.subject: Endurain - A backup code was used
security_change.backup_code_used.heading: A backup code was used
security_change.backup_code_used.intro: A backup code was used for two-step verification on your Endurain account.
security_change.backup_code_used.remaini: You have no unused backup codes left. Generate new ones in Settings → Security.
security_change.refresh_token_reuse_dete: A session of your account was ended

A sign-in session of your Endurain account was ended because a refresh token that had already been used was presented again, which can mean the session was copied. Your other sessions were not affected. Sign in again on the device that was signed out.
security_change.role_changed_by_admin.su: Endurain - An administrator changed your access
security_change.role_changed_by_admin.in: An administrator changed the access of your Endurain account and signed you out of all devices. Sign in again to continue.
An administrator changed the access of your Endurain account to administrator and signed you out of all devices. Sign in again to continue.
An administrator changed the access of your Endurain account to regular user and signed you out of all devices. Sign in again to continue.
security_change.account_deactivated_by_a: Endurain - An administrator deactivated your account
An administrator deactivated your Endurain account and signed you out of all devices. You cannot sign in until an administrator reactivates it.
security_change.account_deletion_request: Endurain - Deletion of your account was requested
Deletion of your account was requested

The deletion of your Endurain account was requested. You were signed out of all devices and the account was deactivated, and your data is being erased in the background. Only an administrator can stop this, by reactivating the account before the erasure finishes.
security_change.username_changed.subject: Endurain - Your username was changed
security_change.username_changed.heading: Your username was changed
security_change.username_changed.intro: The username of your Endurain account was changed.
new_device_sign_in.subject: Endurain - New sign-in to your account
new_device_sign_in.heading: New sign-in to your account
new_device_sign_in.intro: Your Endurain account was signed in to from a device or browser it has not been used on before.
new_device_sign_in.security_notice: If this wasn't you, change your password right away and sign out of your other sessions in Settings → Security, as someone else may have access to your account.
admin_signup.subject: Endurain - New user sign-up pending approval
admin_signup.heading: New sign-up requires approval
admin_signup.intro: A new user has signed up and is awaiting approval:
admin_signup.review: Please log in to the Endurain admin panel to review and approve this request.
admin_promoted.subject: Endurain - A user was made an administrator
admin_promoted.heading: A user was made an administrator
admin_promoted.intro: An administrator gave {name} ({username}) administrator access to Endurain.
admin_promoted.security_notice: If you didn't expect this, review the users in the admin panel right away.
signup_approved.subject: Endurain - Your account has been approved
signup_approved.heading: Your account is now active
signup_approved.intro: Good news! Your account has been approved and is now active.
signup_approved.login_intro: You can now log in and start using Endurain:
signup_existing_account.subject: Endurain - Sign-up attempt with your email
signup_existing_account.heading: Someone tried to sign up with your email
signup_existing_account.intro: Someone used your email address to sign up for Endurain. You already have an account, so nothing was created or changed.
signup_existing_account.login_intro: If it was you, log in with your existing account. If you forgot your password, use the reset option on the login page:
signup_existing_account.ignore: If it was not you, you can ignore this email. No action is needed.
test_email.subject: Endurain - Test email
test_email.heading: Email is working
test_email.intro: This is a test email sent from the Endurain server settings. If you are reading it, Endurain can send email through your SMTP server.
email_change_taken.subject: Endurain - Someone tried to use your email address
email_change_taken.heading: Someone tried to use your email address
email_change_taken.intro: Someone asked to change the email address of another Endurain account to yours. Nothing was changed, and your account is not affected.
email_change_taken.ignore: If it was not you, you can ignore this email. No action is needed.
